title: Technology Sector Update for 12/31/2018: NEON,GOOG,GOOGL,SFET,FB
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +0.74%
AAPL +0.64%
IBM +0.35%
CSCO +1.02%
GOOG -0.83%
Technology stocks were holding on to moderate gains late Monday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding about 0.6%, giving back over half of its prior gain and reversing its 15% decline during 2018. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was up about 0.4% Monday afternoon and falling over 10.5% over the past 12 months.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Neonode ( NEON ) dropped to a more than five-year low on Monday, sinking 10% to $1.70 a share after the interactive optical sensors company said it has closed on a Dec.20 private placement of 2.9 million shares of its common stock at $1.60 apiece, generating $4.7 million in gross proceeds. Insiders purchased all of the available shares, with board member Ulf Rosberg and existing institutional investor Peter Lindell each seeing their respective stakes rise to about 19%.
In other sector news:
(+) Safe-T Group ( SFET ) soared as much as 49% on Monday after the cyber-security firm said it received an order from a large Israeli beverage company for its development environment software and other software-defined access products. The order includes licenses for all of the beverage company's thousands of users as well as an annual maintenance subscription for perpetual licenses.
(-) Alphabet (GOOG,GOOGL) was fractionally lower on Monday, reversing 1.5% gain earlier in the session that followed a US district court dismissing a lawsuit filed against the internet conglomerate by consumers who claimed Google's photo sharing and storage service violated their privacy.
(-) Facebook ( FB ) turned negative this afternoon, dropping almost 2%, following reports the partial government shutdown will force the Federal Trade Commission to suspend its probe into alleged violations of a 2011 consent order requiring the social network company to keep users' personal information private.
